## Overview

During imbalanced DP decode, a rank can have real requests but leave the last captured microbatch empty, causing MRV2 DBO to fall back from FULL CUDA Graph replay. This first layer of the split of #57184 stages those requests into the captured regions and restores logical order after execution. Related issue: #57177.

## Stack and review order

**This is layer 1/6 and the review entry point. It has no dependency on the later five layers.** Next layer: [#63107](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63107).

[Review this commit](https://github.com/algebra-MCX/vllm/commit/bf402744ab70fd1d532be9bf5c3076a71da2983c). Each link in the last column below shows only one module's commit.

| Layer | Official PR | Increment | Depends on | This layer only |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1/6 | [#62430](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62430) | Odd graph sizes and decode staging | upstream main | [commit bf402744ab](https://github.com/algebra-MCX/vllm/commit/bf402744ab70fd1d532be9bf5c3076a71da2983c) |
| 2/6 | [#63107](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63107) | Routed-expert logical row restoration | [#62430](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62430) | [commit c2622dc8b0](https://github.com/algebra-MCX/vllm/commit/c2622dc8b0d4e174898c4623393020ecde241627) |
| 3/6 | [#63108](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63108) | NIXL synchronized execution capacity | [#63107](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63107) | [commit 89e2994d21](https://github.com/algebra-MCX/vllm/commit/89e2994d21e8b60bc339530cf7a917ff9233276f) |
| 4/6 | [#63109](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63109) | NIXL compute/communication stream handoff | [#63108](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63108) | [commit 50569fd01b](https://github.com/algebra-MCX/vllm/commit/50569fd01be61bda12038d9c79fd1e7cb6cb76e4) |
| 5/6 | [#63110](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63110) | Per-microbatch NIXL/shared-expert resources | [#63109](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63109) | [commit 454cbda6ce](https://github.com/algebra-MCX/vllm/commit/454cbda6ce81e548fc2f9b6a8a56b7274e73ba6b) |
| 6/6 | [#63111](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63111) | Synchronized active microbatch count selection | [#63110](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63110) | [commit e4a0ee2534](https://github.com/algebra-MCX/vllm/commit/e4a0ee253490ff5dac7d0c94a81eef20dc1170b3) |

**Review / merge order:** [#62430](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62430) → [#63107](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63107) → [#63108](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63108) → [#63109](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63109) → [#63110](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63110) → [#63111](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63111).

All official PRs target `vllm-project/vllm:main`. Until a parent merges, GitHub's **Files changed** tab for its children includes earlier layers; these are a dependent stack, not six independent patches. Use the single-layer links above for incremental review. After each parent merges, rebase its child onto updated main, retain only the child's increment, and rerun focused checks before proceeding. All six PRs are open for review. Merge in dependency order after the required current-head GPU/model validation and full pre-commit checks are complete. Existing fork PRs retain one-layer comparisons and link back to these official PRs. Related RFC: #57177; split from #57184.

## Claims

- Divide real single-token decode rows across the already captured microbatch regions, including odd graph sizes and more than two regions.
- Scatter through temporary buffers so overlapping source and destination rows do not corrupt inputs; restore logical rows for post-forward consumers.
- Retain FULL replay only when every DP rank satisfies the staging contract. Unsupported layouts keep the existing fallback.

## Validation

Independent check of this exact layer, head `bf402744ab`, 2026-10-22: **62 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped**. Covers staging row/KV mapping, cross-step metadata, real configuration thresholds and DP capability gates.

<details>
<summary>CPU test selection</summary>

Run from this branch with the validated environment active and `PYTHONPATH` pointing at this checkout:

```bash
HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider \
  'tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_ubatch_slicing.py::test_thresholds_below_the_microbatch_count_are_rejected' \
  'tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_ubatch_slicing.py::test_conditional_decode_preserves_token_position_and_kv_mapping' \
  'tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_ubatch_slicing.py::test_staged_prepare_matches_captured_regions_across_steps' \
  'tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_ubatch_slicing.py::test_staging_gate_uses_last_region_start' \
  'tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_ubatch_slicing.py::test_staging_gate_rejects_multitoken_decode' \
  'tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_ubatch_slicing.py::test_staging_capability_checks_data_contract' \
  'tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_ubatch_slicing.py::test_dp_gate_uses_real_staging_capability'
```

</details>

Earlier broader staging selection on this same head: **92 passed, 17 skipped, 29 deselected**.

CPU tests ran with CUDA hidden and offline model loading, using Python 3.12.14, pytest 9.1.1 and torch 2.13.0+cu129. Parts 3–6 additionally loaded the source-pinned `humming-kernels==0.1.17` from an isolated dependency directory; the shared virtual environment was unchanged.

Ruff check/format on all 22 changed Python files, whitespace, test tethering, forbidden-import and config validation checks previously passed on the unchanged final stack. Full pre-commit remains pending.

Real CUDA stream ordering, NIXL collectives/CUDA Graph replay, full-model correctness and performance remain pending.

## Details

**How it works:** the DP decision checks whether any rank's last captured region would be empty. For eligible uniform single-token decode, staging spreads rows across the existing region slices, rebuilds per-region attention metadata, and restores input and output order after the forward pass. Temporary scatter buffers preserve source rows when regions overlap. The path is gated to specific MRV2 model-state and attention layouts with NIXL EP; unsupported auxiliary inputs and parallel layouts remain excluded.

**Review context:** specture724 asked that the prototype support odd graph sizes and more than two microbatches without hard-coded equal halves; this layer applies that region-based approach. aoshen02 requested that #57184 be split. The original combined PR is closed. All six layers now have official upstream PRs; see the stack above.

**Overlap and cost:** #57020 chooses eager fallback at the empty-tail boundary; this PR stages eligible real rows to preserve FULL replay. The predicates must be reconciled before merge. Staging adds copies and temporary buffers, so this layer makes no performance claim.

OpenAI Codex assisted with code preparation, validation, and PR text. Historical model results in #57184 do not validate this head.
